title: rDPS Meter
changeNote: 0.1.21 - damage from the Regent's Black Hole is now credited to Black Hole instead of landing in the unnamed "(none)" row. The power deals its damage in a way that hid which card was behind it, so every star you spent showed up in your total but none of it could be traced to the card that earned it. Rows that were already correct are unchanged. Prompted by that report, every damage-dealing power, relic, orb and card in the game was re-checked for the same problem: Black Hole was the only one still affected, and the tool that does the checking was widened so the two ways it could have missed this cannot hide a source again. Checked against game v0.109.1.
